passives.name: Moment of Entangled Lives
passives.text:
Turn Start: Activate the highest-Stacked state of time between [In the Past], [In the Present], and [In the Future] and use a special Skill
- If multiple states of time share the highest Stack, the currently active state of time does not change
- Inactive states of time become [In the Past (Deactivated)], [In the Present (Deactivated)], or [In the Future (Deactivated)], respectively
- When the currently active state of time changes, gain 1 [Temporal Disjunction]
Every time Illusory Butterfly of Entangled Lives::The Past / The Present / The Future are hit as main targets, Butterfly of Entangled Lives::Imago loses [In the Past] / [In the Present] / [In the Future] Stack
Higher [In the Past] / [In the Present] / [In the Future] Stacks lead to Butterfly of Entangled Lives::Imago's Skill Power and damage output becoming greatly enhanced, and greatly increase the amount of status effects it inflicts or gains

passives.name: Causality that Threads the Past, the Present, and the Future [三世因果]
passives.text:
At 10+ Clashes against the same target, randomly gain or lose Clash Power by (Clash Count / 10) in a Clash (rounded down)
Encounter Start:
- Begin Encounter with the same HP as Butterfly of Entangled Lives::The Pupa (excluding Shield)
- Gain 10 Stacks each of [In the Past] / [In the Present] / [In the Future]
At less than 66%/33% HP, gain new Slot patterns
- When this unit's HP drops below 66%/33% for the first time in this Encounter, gain 10 Stacks each of [In the Past], [In the Present], and [In the Future] next turn

passives.name: Past [過去]

attacking Sinner

passives.name: Present [現在]
passives.text:
When [In the Present], gain the following effects:
- Does not lose [Poise] Count On Crit; Turn Start: gain (2 + # of Sinners) [Poise] and [Poise] Count

passives.name: Future [未來]
passives.text:
When [In the Future], gain the following effects:
- Turn Start: All Sinners gain +(3 + # of current turn / 2) [Bleed] Count (rounded up)
- Skill "Bloodflower" gains Final Power +2 and its final Coin gains "On Hit,
heal ([In the Future] Stack x 3) HP on self" effect
- Whenever [Bleed] activates on self or on Sinners, heal HP equal to the said [Bleed] damage (rounded down)
